tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the open models Smarty Pants serves on Apple Silicon Macs, with exact model ids, prices per million tokens, context size, features and whether each can serve a request right now. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the US dollar cost of running a Smarty Pants model for a given number of input and output tokens and requests. Uses the published per-token prices. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: find_model
tools.description: Find Smarty Pants models that fit a task and constraints (context size, max price, needed features, available now). Returns matches cheapest first, or a suggestion to request a model if none fit. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: request_model
tools.description: Ask Smarty Pants to host a model that is not offered yet. Best with a Hugging Face link or org/name id. We check it at once (license, safe file types, no outside code, fits our Macs) and give you a track link to follow it from requested to checked, in testing and live. Nothing is downloaded or charg

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: How to start using Smarty Pants: sign-up link, free starter credit, the OpenAI-compatible API base URL and a ready-to-run example. No sign-in needed.
